task_intent: Refine Tessera’s personal music library and games with expressive native interfaces and matching wall experiences.

mobbin.observed: A compact album cover grid, search field and an anchored sort menu with Recently Added, Record Name, Artist Name and Release Date.
mobbin.applied: One persistent collection view with five native sort choices and a search field; controls stay beside the records instead of creating a second collection popup.

mobbin.observed: Strong Library masthead; real album artwork carries the color; grouped navigation is secondary to the cover collection.
mobbin.applied: Actual collection covers form a record stack above warm typographic counts; pressing rows open a native pushed detail page.

primary_web.applied: Search filters the current collection in place; clear-search and a contextual no-results state preserve orientation.
Adaptive collection grid becomes one column at accessibility text sizes; count rows and sorting controls wrap rather than truncate.
Keep exact pressing identity and catalogue details; multiple owned copies of one release have one navigable row and an explicit copy count. Discogs remains the place to edit collection membership.

composition: Current owned artwork is shown using the actual wall RGB frame. The collection portrait is clearly the personal library and does not pretend to be a wall preview. Existing production owned_mark output is preserved.
